newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon starts C&W Comms.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon starts C&W Comms.

text.p: C&W Communications Plc was rated "strong buy" at Salomon Brothers as the investment bank started coverage of the stock and set a 12-month price target of 500p, Salomon said on Monday.
Salomon analysts said the company's ability to bundle telephone and multichannel television services was a key advantage for the group, which made its market debut on April 28.

They said massive synergy benefits of up to 200 million stg could flow in the next 24-36 months and that even ignoring TV, it had a cost advantage over BT and a higher-capacity network that could support more applications.
It could also become part of a global alliance since Global One's owners -- Deutsche Telecom, France Telecom and Sprint -- had already shown interest in C&W, Salomon analysts said.
